title: Thursday and the balance in words
script:
SPEAKING: Say the amount and the Thursday in words.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-04 case. You want 6 November, then you accept the full 1250 on Thursday 15 October 2026.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- the full 1250 on 6 November → say that is the day you want
- the full 1250 on Thursday 15 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: 1250 and 15 October are spoken in words
